description: Preview the BZB daily trading-rewards leaderboard for a UTC day from live BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap logs, using the swap-desk rules: no minimum trade, no per-wallet cap, same-wallet round trips within 10 minutes netted, top 50 listed, top 25 paid fixed shares of the daily cap. Optional account shows its rank, points, estimated BZB and points needed for a paid slot. An ESTIMATE, not a payment: only poster-posted winners are paid. Polygon only (chain 137).

account.description: Optional: show this address's rank, points and gap to a paid slot.

dayId.description: UTC day number = floor(unix/86400). Default: today.
